units.source_text: 沙丘呈半月形，如同耸起的城墙围绕着村落，沿着沙丘的山脊线，男人低头挪着步子。

en.t: The dunes formed a crescent, surrounding the village like raised castle walls, and along the ridgeline of the dunes the man moved forward with his head lowered.

units.source_text: 他几乎一点都不在意远处的景色。

en.t: He paid almost no attention at all to the distant scenery.

units.source_text: 采集昆虫标本的人，必须只对脚下方圆三米左右的地方集中全部的精力。

en.t: A person collecting insect specimens has to focus all of his energy only on the ground within about three meters around his feet.

units.source_text: 他们尽可能不让太阳从背后照射过来，这也是必要的注意事项之一。

en.t: They also try as much as possible not to let the sun shine from behind them, which is one of the necessary precautions.

units.source_text: 假如背朝着太阳，自己的影子会吓跑昆虫。

en.t: If they turn their backs to the sun, their own shadows will frighten the insects away.

units.source_text: 所以，采集家们的额头和鼻尖，老是给太阳晒得黑黑的。

en.t: That is why collectors always have foreheads and the tips of their noses darkened by the sun.
